description: ONS Open Data Portal is an open dataset on Amazon S3 listed in Registry of Open Data on AWS, a registry of open datasets hosted on Amazon S3 under the section "energy", published or maintained by ONS - National Electric System Operator. The ONS Open Data Portal, produced by the National Operator of the Electric System (ONS), gathers historical data from the Brazilian electricity sector in an easy and democratic way with the main objective to facilitate and improve the access and consumption of this type of content by all users and audiences. Coverage: as stated on the registry page. The registry lists it under the tag energy and hosts it on Amazon S3. Update frequency: diary. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY 4.0 (as given on the registry page). Caveats: this record was written from the registry page, which was read; the data on S3 were not opened, the licence text was shortened, and the description may lag the source. It can support data-driven infrastructure planning and analysis. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-registry-of-open-data-on-aws.
